description: Deribit public REST API: option instrument listings and the Deribit Volatility Index (DVOL). No API key; read-only.
permission_basis: Public market data served without authentication by Deribit public REST endpoints (/public/get_volatility_index_data), used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. Deribit Terms of Service and API documentation reviewed 2026-11-18. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
timestamp_basis: DVOL hourly rows are OHLC rows [timestamp_ms, open, high, low, close] timestamped on the hour in UTC; a row's close becomes knowable at the next hour boundary. This study takes the close of the row timestamped 15:00 UTC as the 16:00 UTC daily snapshot, aligned to the OKX 1D bar grid (bars open 16:00 UTC). Daily DVOL points (resolution 86400) are timestamped at 00:00 UTC; this study does not use them.
